title: OperatorClassification
description: Doorway-operator authority encoded as an REA Commitment. NOT a new entry type — uses the existing Commitment entry (elohim DNA, content_store_integrity zome) with action='operate-doorway'. This schema declares the controlled vocabulary for the three Commitment fields that carry the operator binding: resource_classified_as (capability set, queryable list), in_scope_of (doorway scope reference), and metadata_json (succession role and versioning). The doorway's projection layer reads active operate-doorway commitments by indexing (action, in_scope_of) on the rea_commitments table — no new physical projection table required. Source of truth: Holochain DHT (Notarized, Category A — existing Commitment entry type).

schemaVersion.description: Schema version. v1 omits custody/steward references (transition window — auth chain enforcement comes online with v2). v2 adds required custodyAttestationHash + stewardAttestationHash referencing the two-layer attestation chain above operator commitments. Producers SHOULD emit v2 once the doorway has the bootstrap attestations in place; readers MUST accept both during the transition.

action.description: REA action discriminator. Always 'operate-doorway' for operator commitments. Distinct from 'custody-blob', 'serve-blob', etc. — those are storage-stewardship actions on the same Commitment entry type.

capabilities.description: Capability strings stored as the Commitment's resource_classified_as field (a list, queryable via existing idx_rea_commitments_action_resource index). Each string is a dot-separated capability path 'subsystem.operation' matching an admin endpoint declaration in doorway-service. Authority is checked at request time by membership in this list.

scopes.description: Scope references stored as the Commitment's in_scope_of field (a list). Each entry is a typed prefix 'kind:identifier'. The 'doorway:<id>' prefix names which doorway this operator authority applies to and MUST match an existing DoorwayRegistration.id.

successionRole.description: Role within the doorway's succession plan. Primary is the bootstrap operator (matches DoorwayRegistration.operator_agent). Deputies have full or narrowed capability scope. Recovery-witnesses can only act under quorum recovery flow.

reachScope.description: Reach class of the commitment itself — who can audit this operator's authority. 'operator-private' = visible only to fellow operators of the same doorway; 'stewards-only' = visible to all stewards of the broader network; 'public' = visible in any topology rollup.

custodyAttestationHash.description: ActionHash of the active HardwareCustodyAttestation (kind='hardware-custody') the operator serves under. Required when schemaVersion=2; ignored when schemaVersion=1. The auth chain is custody -> steward -> operator-commitment; supersession of the referenced custody attestation orphans this commitment until re-blessed under new custody. See attestation/subtypes/hardware-custody-metadata.schema.json.

stewardAttestationHash.description: ActionHash of the active StewardOfRecordAttestation (kind='steward-of-record') the operator serves under. Required when schemaVersion=2; ignored when schemaVersion=1. Stewardship supersession orphans this commitment independently of custody. See attestation/subtypes/steward-of-record-metadata.schema.json.
